# Source: original fixture

Authored for the trustabl test corpus. Synthetic agent guidance files (CLAUDE.md,
GEMINI.md, a Cursor .mdc rule, .windsurfrules and a GitHub Copilot instructions
file), each with plain text and one run of Unicode Tags-block characters (U+E0000
block) that spells the word "placeholder", for AGCFG-013. The Tags characters are
invisible; list them with a hidden-character viewer. No external code. Public-domain.
